heading: Educational assistance: former captives

tree.text: In order to respond to special circumstances, the Secretary concerned may pay (by advancement or reimbursement) a person who is a former captive for expenses incurred, while attending an educational or training institution, for—
Except as provided in section 2184 of this title, payments shall be available under this section for a person who is a former captive for education or training that occurs—

children.text: after the termination of the status of that person as a captive; and
the end of any semester or quarter (as appropriate) that begins before the end of the 10-year period beginning on the date on which the status of that person as a captive terminates; or

if the educational or training institution is not operated on a semester or quarter system, the earlier of the end of any course that began before such date or the end of the 16-week period following that date.

tree.text: Payments shall be available under this section only to the extent that such payments are not otherwise authorized by law.

notes.text: Effective DateSection applicable with respect to persons whose captive status begins after Jan. 21, 1981, see section 806(d)(3) of Pub. L. 99–399, set out as a note under 2181 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 99–399, title VIII, § 806(d)(1), Aug. 27, 1986, 100 Stat. 888.)
